title: ynh backend list --format json
description: Output of `ynh backend list --format json`. Bare array of configured local model backends. Envelope retrofit deferred, matching the other Phase 3 commands.

backend.description: The backend's name, as given to `ynh backend add`.

vendor.description: Which vendor CLI this connection redirects. One backend may carry a connection per vendor.

type.description: Backend protocol or flavour, when the vendor needs it to build a request.

base_url.description: Where the vendor CLI is redirected to.

has_auth_token.description: Whether an auth token is recorded. The token itself is never emitted — this says only that one exists, so a consumer can tell a configured backend from an unauthenticated one without the value leaking into logs or a trajectory.

models.description: Models discovered on the backend. Discovery is best-effort: an unreachable backend yields an empty list rather than an error, so absence does not mean the backend is broken.
